source_basis: user-provided v1.9.1 Native QR Picker ZIP, subsequently extended with the CCWU Global portal frontend and Supabase backend
notes: Version 2.0.3 is a static portal plus Supabase backend source release; it is not a frontend-only diagnostic package.
Admin entrypoint is loaded as an ES module from admin-v2.0.1.js with an explicit cache-busting version.
Test and production Supabase host mappings are isolated; unknown hosts fail closed.
Six tracked Edge Functions and 53 database migrations are included in source.
USD recurring membership and VPN plans require configured Stripe Price IDs.
CNY payment integrations remain disabled until merchant credentials and callback tests are completed.
No provider secrets or service-role keys belong in public source files.
Production merge and deployment are separate release gates requiring explicit authorization.
